pipeline.SCOUT: 12 full games known, live one excluded, 11 upcoming
pipeline.VERIFY: Public price sources are stale/not executable and only old-season PF/PA
pipeline.GAME_SENSE: SHADOW-HOLD turnover event timing not fed to these forecasts
pipeline.ORACLE: simple 2025-26 PF/PA cross-team expected score versus unverified HoopVantage model; averages are screens not probabilities
pipeline.EDGE_THIEF: Line movement, team reconstruction, minutes conflict, flawed betting split inference, weak model validation; negative tests preserved
pipeline.PRICING: Only published market benchmarks with implied break-even, no book-verified executable/current quote and no calibrated fair chance
pipeline.SENTINEL: No selections authorized BET, all INVESTIGATE/WATCH/PASS
pipeline.TACTICIAN: 3 conditional FOUNDATION singles + 2 alternates + optional 2-leg crossgame EXPEDITION double
pipeline.FINAL_GATE: Human needs current DK actual line/odds, player status and bankroll confirmation
pipeline.LEDGER: No bets placed, no real settlement receipts

formula: Neutral old-season team projection = ((A PF + B PA)/2)+((B PF + A PA)/2). Shadow midpoint with external model is EXPLORATORY not calibrated EV or independent true forecast.
